author: Sadslet
body:
I don't deserve a 24 hour ban for promoting the safety of YouTube. Announcing "kys" on public chat helps
members of the Avicus/ YouTube community safe. Especially after all of the drama and hate going on around
the YouTube community. I would like to appeal for my unjust ban. I have just joined this server today and
would like the Avicus Network Staff to review my case.

REVISION: Case Number 650311
https://avicus.net/punishments/650311 
I also was warned, but the ban came in seconds after my kick.

title: 24 hr ban

replies.author: Midnightstorm
replies.body:
Hello Sadslet.

You were punished for telling another player in chat to "kys". This is not something that will be tolerated on the Avicus Network. Your temporary ban will last from June 8th, 2016 - June 22nd, 2016. I will leave this post open if you have any questions or concerns.

Sincerely,
Midnightstorm

replies.author: Sadslet
replies.body:
what?, not a 24 hour ban? I didn't know it was tolerated. I literally just joined the server. kys means to keep youtube safe. Uhh thats what they told me in the youtube comments. I didn't even get a warn. Please clairfy. 
btw the I can't view the actions and punishments link. I actually thought this was a 24 hour ban though, but week ban is a bit too much.

replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body:
Hello Sadslet.

Please refer to Midnightstorm. You blankly said "Kys" in chat which has never meant "Keep Youtube Safe". Loopholes like this will not help you. What you have said in Chat could have been mistaken to other players for, what most of us know as, "Kill Yourself" which players could have taken offense to it. You added no context into what you said In chat so all we can assume is you tried to say "Kill yourself" due to your poor chat behavior (when looking at your logs). This appeal is denied.

Regards,
Edans
